hooks.logic:
Count up "fingerTipTurn".
Let currentBpIdxByCurrentParamSuffixNo be the phase matching the current form of the enemy under the phases list.
Let paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs be the form for the enemy under the phases list.
If condition flag "changeToTornado" is up this frame, then
  Set the register's 'nextBpIdx' to currentBpIdxByCurrentParamSuffixNo.
  Set the register's 'canChangeToTornado' to false.
  Choose state 15 next and stop.
If condition flag "fingerTip" is up this frame, then set the register's 'canChangeToTornado' to true.
If the current form of the enemy is not paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs, then
  The enemy changes to form paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs.
  The enemy cancels its cast and stop.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  If the register's 'canChangeToTornado', then the enemy uses the move labelled "changeToTornado" and stop.
  Let v be unset.
  Let number be the numeric entry list at currentBpIdxByCurrentParamSuffixNo's 'fingerTipLotTurn' in the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
  If the count "fingerTipTurn" is less than number, then
    Let excludedAbilityListBySmartLot be the enemy → get-excluded-ability-list-by-smart-lot.
    Append (the id of the move labelled "fingerTip" on the enemy) to excludedAbilityListBySmartLot.
    Set v to a weighted random move of the enemy other than excludedAbilityListBySmartLot.
  Otherwise, set v to a smart-weighted move of the enemy.
  The enemy uses v.

flow.text: Let currentBpIdxByCurrentParamSuffixNo be the phase matching the current form of the enemy under the phases list.
Let paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs be the form for the enemy under the phases list.
condition flag "changeToTornado" is up this frame
condition flag "fingerTip" is up this frame
the current form of the enemy is not paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs

yes.text: The enemy changes to form paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs.

flow.text: the enemy is ready to act

yes.text: The enemy uses the move labelled "changeToTornado".
Let number be the numeric entry list at currentBpIdxByCurrentParamSuffixNo's 'fingerTipLotTurn' in the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
the count "fingerTipTurn" is less than number
Let excludedAbilityListBySmartLot be the enemy → get-excluded-ability-list-by-smart-lot.
Append (the id of the move labelled "fingerTip" on the enemy) to excludedAbilityListBySmartLot.
Set v to a weighted random move of the enemy other than excludedAbilityListBySmartLot.

no.text: Set v to a smart-weighted move of the enemy.

hooks.logic:
Repeat, starting with let self be the acting enemy also let globalRegister be the script register also let resultObjectsInFrame be the results "flightAttack" this frame also let nextBpIdx be globalRegister's 'nextBpIdx', while nextBpIdx is less than the length of list, stepping nextBpIdx before increasing
  Let v be list at nextBpIdx.
  If v's 'hpRateAiArg' and the numeric entry v's 'hpRateAiArg' in the battle settings of the group of self is at least the HP fraction of self, then set globalRegister's 'nextBpIdx' to nextBpIdx.
If the length of resultObjectsInFrame is more than 0, then
  Let v2 be false.
  For each x in resultObjectsInFrame
    If x's 'isFlightAttack', then set v2 to true.
  If v2, then choose state 14 next and stop.
  If condition flag "counter" is up this frame, then self → register-interrupt-ability-by-tag with ("counterTornado", {isCounter: true}, {interruptCounter: true}).
If self is ready to act, then self picks and uses a smart-weighted move.

flow.text: Repeat, starting with let self be the acting enemy also let globalRegister be the script register also let resultObjectsInFrame be the results "flightAttack" this frame also let nextBpIdx be globalRegister's 'nextBpIdx', while nextBpIdx is less than the length of list, stepping nextBpIdx before increasing

body.text: Let v be list at nextBpIdx.
v's 'hpRateAiArg' and the numeric entry v's 'hpRateAiArg' in the battle settings of the group of self is at least the HP fraction of self

flow.text: the length of resultObjectsInFrame is more than 0

yes.text: condition flag "counter" is up this frame
Self picks and uses a smart-weighted move.

hooks.logic:
Let list2 be [[{deformTag: "deformation_01"}], [{builtin: "CHANGE_PARAM", paramSuffixNo: "4"}]].
Queue the pose-change sequence list2.
Put queued moves ahead of counters.

flow.text: Put queued moves ahead of counters.

hooks.logic:
Let list2 be [[{deformTag: "deformation_02"}], [{builtin: "CHANGE_PARAM", paramSuffixNo: list at (the register's 'nextBpIdx')'s 'paramSuffixNo'}]].
Queue the pose-change sequence list2.
Put queued moves ahead of counters.
Reset the count "fingerTipTurn".

flow.text: Let list2 be [[{deformTag: "deformation_02"}], [{builtin: "CHANGE_PARAM", paramSuffixNo: list at (the register's 'nextBpIdx')'s 'paramSuffixNo'}]].
Put queued moves ahead of counters.
